scope: One authenticated upstream Red TRAIN trainer root; isolated teacher setup and model-owned cartridge battles only

factory_repair.finding: Synthetic reserve owner IDs were zero rather than the source player's owner ID, causing live selected attacks to consume no PP and no damage after a voluntary switch
factory_repair.verification: A private-ROM switch into Squirtle followed by Water Gun now executes and damages Geodude; reserve owner IDs are checked in ROM-free and live tests
factory_repair.effect_on_prior_evidence: Earlier same-root fit and holdout are superseded because their synthetic reserve cartridge states were defective

retained_falsifiers.case: first repaired four-case challenger on unseen s6 TRAIN matchup
retained_falsifiers.conclusion: No switching advantage; the model lost more HP on every timing

retained_falsifiers.case: eight-case challenger on unseen s11 TRAIN matchup before policy repair
retained_falsifiers.failure: Repeated switching led to optional replacement prompts with no living reserve; target projection raised instead of declining
retained_falsifiers.disposition: All five failed runs retained and closed without replay or replacement

changes: Decline an optional replacement prompt when there is no legal target
After a voluntary switch, mask another voluntary switch against the same opponent until a model-selected attack is attempted; forced switches and depleted attacks remain legal
controller_repair.claim: A disclosed action-safety boundary, not learned post-switch value

fresh_train_holdout.scenario: s12 Bulbasaur versus Pidgey with Pikachu and Charmander reserves
fresh_train_holdout.model_opening_choices: Voluntary switch to party slot 2 in all five trials
fresh_train_holdout.interpretation: Positive same-root synthetic TRAIN transfer versus one attack-only control, after a disclosed runtime switch-safety rule; not natural or independently rooted validation

remaining_gates: Four independent authenticated TRAIN trainer roots with four admitted scenarios each, including main, prompt, forced and depleted-attack contexts
Disjoint natural DEVELOPMENT comparison against both frozen and fixed controls
Sustained model-owned battles without a teacher fallback and without relying on the switch-safety mask for value learning
Only then consider battle authority or a fresh Red acceptance run
